_about: Output of the reference Python pipeline (numpy/pandas/scipy) on the synthetic rows from tests/fixtures/messy.ts. No real students.

normality.verdict: Not normal — national exam scores are typically non-Gaussian (bounded, skewed, with mass at pass boundaries). Reported for completeness.

normal_fit_pct.note: Best-fit Gaussian overlay parameters for the percentage distribution.

gap_analysis.description: Adjacent 1%-bin count differences reveal where the population thins or piles up.

duplicates.note_names: Duplicate names are expected in a national dataset (different people share common names); seat numbers are the true unique key.

rules: passing_but_zero_score: status pass/round2 yet score is 0
invalid.note: Flagged rows are status–score inconsistencies, not corrupt data: students marked passed / second-round yet carrying a recorded total of exactly 0 (score withheld or not released in this file). They are retained in the database and in status totals, but excluded from the ranked score distribution so a placeholder zero cannot distort ranks, percentiles, or the mean.
